plan.title: Annual Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: Total contributions, payment method distribution, and monthly trends for the current year

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS n FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%'

panels.title: Total Transactions
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%'

panels.title: Donations by Payment Mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode" AS mode, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT SUBSTR("Date", 1, 7) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top 5 Donors
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor" AS donor, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
